description: "Broadcast Days On TV only on TV !!!"  New series "Word" every Monday at 20:00 at Star !!  Türkiye's largest production of soldiers, TIMS & B Production signed by Söz, 1st part of the Star TV screens began broadcasting.    The 'Word', which was held in cooperation with the General Staff and the Ministry of National Defense for the first time in Türkiye, is about the story of a "Special Force Team".  Preliminary preparations, which lasted for 1 year and continued to shoot for about 3 months, 'Senior Lieutenant and Tim Commander Yavuz role in the role of successful actor Tolga Sarıtaş; Other members of this special team walking to death without blinking for his homeland, Atakan Arslan, Burak Sevinç, Görkem Sevindik, Mustafa Yıldıran, Eren Vurdem, Aytaç Şaşmaz, Mehmet Ali Karakuş, Doğukan Polat, Volkan Uygun, Oktay Samurkaş are portrayed.   The terror disaster changes Lieutenant Yavuz's life   As a result of a major terrorist attack in Istanbul, dozens of people lost their lives and this disaster caused a major outrage in the country, and the life of Senior Lieutenant Yavuz Karasu (Tolga Sarıtaş) is dragged into a new flow.   SPECIAL STRUCTURE TERM IS CREATED  When the terrorist organization that undertakes the attack, as a second action, a civilian citizen missed a citizen, it is decided to create a new team within the Special Forces Command in order to capture the head of the organization and complete the rescue work.  While the time is gradually narrowing to save the hostage, Senior Lieutenant Yavuz Karasu, who is the commander of the team, takes action at the expense of endangering his own life. The team, whose ways united in the love of the homeland, will be both siblings and homeland and trench.
